description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of globbing patterns, specifically in the context of Git's path globbing performance. It sets up test repositories, runs performance tests with different glob patterns, and outputs the results.

methods.name: test_perf_fresh_repo
methods.description: Sets up a fresh test repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a success criteria block for tests, executing the given commands.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for loop iterations.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified parameters in the test repository.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with a given description and command.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
